Informações sobre assinaturas
• Se você optar por uma assinatura com renovação automática, sua Conta Apple será cobrada quando confirmar a compra.
• Ela será renovada automaticamente, a menos que você cancele pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período atual.
• A renovação será cobrada nas 24 horas anteriores ao encerramento do período, pelo preço de renovação aplicável exibido.
• Você poderá gerenciar ou cancelar essa assinatura nos ajustes de assinaturas da sua Conta Apple.

pt-BR.short_field_semantics: Name/subtitle identify invitation design and relevant occasions. Keywords describe supported invitation content, visual editing or image output; no competitor brands, unrelated terms, false feature claims, identical entries or literal title/subtitle keyword stuffing found. Related native search synonyms (for example fonts/typefaces) are not duplicate entries; this is not a guarantee of indexing efficiency. Own app name and Apple account attribution are appropriate names, not competitor stuffing.
pt-BR.localization_assessment: Brazilian você register, com a sua cara, chá de bebê and rascunhos fit local usage. Personal greetings and manual second-language entry remain separate from interface language. No material repetitive padding.

• Она продлится автоматически, если не отменить её минимум за 24 часа до конца текущего периода.
• Плата за продление взимается в течение 24 часов до окончания периода по указанной применимой цене продления.
• Управлять такой подпиской и отменять её можно в настройках подписок вашего Аккаунта Apple.

ru.short_field_semantics: Name/subtitle identify invitation design and relevant occasions. Keywords describe supported invitation content, visual editing or image output; no competitor brands, unrelated terms, false feature claims, identical entries or literal title/subtitle keyword stuffing found. Related native search synonyms (for example fonts/typefaces) are not duplicate entries; this is not a guarantee of indexing efficiency. Own app name and Apple account attribution are appropriate names, not competitor stuffing.
ru.localization_assessment: Coherent polite plural imperatives with local phrasing and practical address examples. Some technical terms such as предпросмотрами are stylistically formal but understandable. Distinct design, personalization, reuse and sharing steps; no material padding.

limitations: Independent editorial and frozen-source review, not native-speaker certification or proof of how text was generated. Shared factual structure across locales is acceptable; counts alone are not evidence of good prose.
No build, device, export, purchase or backend execution. Source controls and the supplied audit support implementation claims, not runtime reliability or cutout quality.

APPLE_RULES.md is the supplied policy record. This review did not refresh live Apple documentation or resolve its 100-character versus 100-byte keyword conflict. Eight keyword strings exceed 100 UTF-8 bytes; byte counts are reported separately. Passing owner-requested Unicode limits does not assert App Store Connect acceptance.

Owner explicitly retained both legal URLs and will correct the website product name later. The known website naming mismatch is a retained limitation, not a copy rejection. Exact footer strings were checked; live availability, legal adequacy and completion of that website correction were not verified. Frozen app legal configuration remains about:blank.
Frozen proProductID is empty. Conditional disclosures do not establish an available purchasable product, working purchase integration, price, duration or entitlement.

Competitor reports are historical source material and proposed direction, not instructions or evidence of shipped Pro gating, ten-language UI, automatic translation, RSVP, delivery tracking or export-version tracking. Their market and pricing statements were not reverified.

Only REVIEW.json and REVIEW.md are written. The supplied validator was not run because it writes other deliverables; hashes, counts, structure and diffs were independently computed in memory. No upload, approval request, Apple acceptance or owner final approval.
